اصطحبن (form VIII)

# اُصْطُحِبْنَ (uṣṭuḥibna) /usˤ.tˤu.ħib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# اِصْطَحِبْنَ (iṣṭaḥibna) /isˤ.tˤa.ħib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
